title: Fact-type bundle
description: A declared body of fact types taken up wholesale by an adoption act (Ontology §4, Adoption; milestone-scoped minimal form). Nested fact types name their own schema version and are validated against it. Widens bundle.v1's nested-fact-type schema acceptance to also permit fact-type.v3 (ADR-0041); bundle.v1 is untouched and remains correct for bundles carrying only fact-type.v1 content. (bundle.v2 is unrelated pre-existing content — ADR-0028's versioned-identity surface — not a predecessor of this file.)
